<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope (M, M+1 ≈ 8 % of M, M+2 ≈ 0.5 % of M, rapidly decreasing thereafter) the pattern matches the natural carbon isotopic distribution (C‑12/C‑13) for a molecule containing several carbons. No other element shows a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S would give much larger M+2 peaks). Therefore the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
